name: Logo pop
description: A logo or small image pops in with a short label. Use when the speaker names a brand, app or product and you have its real logo file.

image.description: The logo or image: a file path (png, jpg, webp, svg), or a data: URL.

text.description: Optional label under the logo, e.g. the name as said.

background.description: card = logo and label on one card. bare = logo alone with a shadow. white = white tile with a dark outline (for logos that wash out).

labelAt.description: Seconds from the start when the label lands.

layout.description: top = card above the head, speaker stays visible. full = covers the frame (speaker hidden).

theme.description: light = warm white card, dark = near-black card, accent = card in the accent colour.

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees. Default 0: a logo is never tilted.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Leave out to use the template's own length.

drift.description: Slow push-in over the clip (0 = perfectly still).

region.description: Optional box (frame px, 1080x1920) the content must stay inside; the engine passes the free space above the face.
